_readme: Real characters, drawn by Bird Design and owned by the authors (src/data/rights.json). SVGs in public/art/characters/ were split from the artist's character sheets by scripts/ (see docs/DECISIONS.md). Ids are descriptive, not the characters' official names; rename when Mark supplies names. w and h are the SVG viewBox size, used to prevent layout shift.
